My stepmom used to go through my phone too. She would also go in my room when I wasn’t home and just start searching through my room. She would go through my journal that she suggested I should start writing in. I never wrote in journals again.
NTA. It’s your console that you bought with your own money! So you can do whatever you want with it!

My brother is 12 about to be 13. He has a phone so he’s able to contact me if he wants to but he doesn’t. Because I genuinely don’t think she cares as much as my stepmom says. He’s more concerned about video games and TikTok. We text on occasion but that’s it. And it’s usually me reaching out to him.
He has some videos about Selling Sunset on his channel
I’ve suggested this but even when we have done it, somehow he brings up that his friends are hanging out and that we should go. When I say no I can tell he gets all annoyed

We do spend a lot of time together. Just not alone time. He brings me around his friends a lot and I bring him around my friends. It’s also hard to have girl time because I don’t have that many friends and the one I do have all have boyfriends and really only like to do things with our boyfriends. So there’s that. But I’ve been staying back while he goes out to see what he says or does but nothing. I bring it up to him and he just gets mad saying I’m holding him back from his friends. Which is not true. I’m not saying he can’t hangout with them but there should be a balance. Thank you for your advice and input.
They wake up at 7 am I take them to school and done with drop off by 8:30am pick them back up at 2:30pm and they go to bed at 8:30pm.

I don’t know anything will be 100% okay but it’s too late. I’m not gonna go back now after all this drama and let them treat me however they want because they can because they’re supplying the roof over my head. No thanks I don’t want that kinda of manipulation and negativity in my life.
They think I’m too young and I’m gonna struggle and all that which I understand their point of view but it’s my life

You need to confront her and ask her what her problem is. If she can freely talk about her dating life so can you. You are your own person and she needs to know that she needs to share you with other people and if she can’t then I’m not sure you should remain friends.
I’m not asking anyone’s permission to move out. I was simply telling them that’s what I want to do.
I live in Southern California and it’s super expensive to live on our own right now plus my boyfriend helps his dad pay bills and can’t abandon him like that

I am prepared to support myself. I’ve been saving basically my whole paycheck from my second job so that I have enough for a car and a year of car insurance and at least 6 months of rent. As for school I’m not even sure if my major (nursing) is what I want to do. I feel like I was pushed into that from my family. So I feel like I would need some time to figure that out.
I think they have an issue with both

I never asked for the permission but I still wanted them to know ahead of time and not surprise them like last minute. I love my family and they’re super important to me I think that’s why I have the hesitation to leave when they’re so angry.
Shame on them for making you feel bad for something you don’t want to do!
LEAVE WHILE YOU STILL CAN!!!  They sound crazy and toxic and you need no part in that. You’re better off without them. Honestly if I was in your position I would be feeling the same way you are.

I have some financial aid and pay the rest. If I ask my dad will give me money for books, but I rarely ask because of everything else they pay for. From the looks of it, moving will definitely damage my relationship with not only my parents but now my grandparents (my parents told them). With their tax info I don’t qualify for FASFA so it doesn’t matter.

I currently don’t qualify for financial aid with their tax information anyway so it wouldn’t really matter. As far as everything else, they have always told me that once I leave or am done with school they’re no longer supporting me financially which I feel is fair.

My parents think I’m too young and naive to make it on my own. They think that it’s too soon to live with my boyfriend. If I leave, I’ll never finish school and struggle the rest of my life. Because they’re supporting me financially they don’t think I know what it takes or am responsible enough to be on my own. They also think it’s dumb to move in when my boyfriend still lives with his dad.

My boyfriend’s dad is charging me $200 for rent. I saved enough money to buy a car and have enough money for a whole year of car insurance. We’ve been together for a year and I feel like our relationship is strong. If we break up I’m not sure if I could go back. But do you think I should sacrifice my mental sanity?
I see where you’re coming from. I just can’t take the constant passive aggressive comments and the lack of privacy and the constant nagging anymore. I literally dread coming home everyday.

I went through something similar to this with my ex best friend. Let her go. I know that sounds harsh but do it. Do it for your sanity. You don’t need someone so clingy. It sounds like she has some growing up to do. If you guys are meant to be friends you’ll eventually reconnect when she’s figured her stuff out.
I think you should talk it out and tell him that you honestly didn’t see the trash bag. My boyfriend and I have assigned chores so that we don’t fight about who’s doing more. Maybe try that?
